title: FOG OF WAR FIXES
why: review of v35.14 (his fog of war words 10-27)
now: with fog of war on: ground in plain view counts as seen whichever way you face (facing west it did not, so it was never marked explored); turning in Superhot opens the live view at once and marks the ground you look at; wall hits in sight always show their puff and sparks; smoke clouds in plain view show; pixel look blasts out of sight stay hidden
